description: Implementation of the MasqueClient class for managing QUIC MASQUE protocol sessions, including connection setup, session creation, and settings handling.

classes.name: MasqueClient
classes.description: A client class for managing MASQUE protocol sessions over QUIC, including connection setup, session management, and settings handling.

classes.name: MasqueClientSession
classes.description: Represents a MASQUE session within the MasqueClient, handling session-specific details.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static factory method to create and initialize a MasqueClient instance, establishing connection and receiving settings.

methods.name: CreateQuicClientSession
methods.description: Creates a new QUIC client session for MASQUE.

methods.name: connection_id
methods.description: Returns the connection ID of the MASQUE session.

methods.name: authority
methods.description: Returns the authority string derived from the URI template.

methods.name: OnSettingsReceived
methods.description: Callback invoked when MASQUE settings are received.

methods.name: WaitUntilSettingsReceived
methods.description: Blocks until MASQUE settings are received or connection is lost.
